properties.description: Reusable native-only internal helper for Cisco Intersight - Rename workload deployment. Keeps scalar preparation or polling below platform action and variable limits. No API calls, credentials or hardware targets. Import this helper before its caller; current-cloud native runtime verification remains required. Full internal purpose: Cisco Intersight - Native Rename workload deployment - Prepare bounded native poll delay. Integer seconds are required by Cisco Calculate Date and Sleep.
